Propose the validation rules for the columns above (and for whole records where useful). Return JSON only.

rules.condition: The same complete record (id, beer name, brewery and attributes) must not appear twice in a batch
rules.reason: Each record includes an identifier, so an exact duplicate points to a pipeline duplication error

rules.condition: Serving size must be a number followed by an ounce unit (oz, OZ, ounce), optionally with a trailing period and descriptor such as 'Alumi-Tek'
rules.reason: All observed values are textual sizes such as '12.0 oz.', '19.2 OZ.' and '16.0 oz. Alumi-Tek'. A value without a numeric size and an ounce unit is malformed

rules.condition: Alcohol by volume, as a fraction, must lie between 0 and 0.2
rules.reason: ABV is stored as a fraction (observed range 0.038-0.099). Strong craft beers can exceed 0.1 but rarely exceed 0.2. Values above 1 would indicate percentages entered on the wrong scale, and negative values are impossible

rules.condition: International Bitterness Units must lie between 0 and 200
rules.reason: Observed IBU values range from 5 to 130. Very bitter beers can exceed this, but values above 200 or below 0 are implausible

rules.condition: Beer style must not be missing
rules.reason: Style was present in 100% of the training records

rules.condition: Brewery city must not be missing
rules.reason: City was present in 100% of the training records

rules.condition: When present, the state must be a valid two-letter US state code or DC
rules.reason: The breweries are US craft breweries and state is a closed set of US postal codes. Not all codes appear in the sample, but all of them are legitimate
